items.title: China’s Xi greets Putin and Trump at APEC before historic summit
items.excerpt: Chinese President Xi Jinping greeted Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin at APEC summit.

items.title: Google’s driverless car hits a roadblock

items.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar

items.title: Hegseth unveils new US-Venezuela military deal

items.excerpt: At least eight Palestinians were injured after a settler driver was caught on camera running them over.

items.title: German FA backs France’s Diallo for FIFA presidency
items.excerpt: Incumbent Gianni Infantino has resisted repeated calls to resign, citing overwhelming global support.

items.title: Kenya’s milk shortage deepens as drought hits farmers and pushes up prices

items.excerpt: AI giant's prices shares at $83 in blockbuster market debut.
